name: UBC Future Global Leaders (on campus)
org: UBC Extended Learning, University of British Columbia
what_you_do: Take a university-style academic course or mini school taught by UBC professors and instructors on the Vancouver campus, with workshops and social activities. You get a letter of completion.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 15 to 18 who have completed grade 10 or equivalent. UBC recommends about a 78% average, 3.5 GPA, B average or IB 5. Students still learning English should have IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 or higher. Open to students from other countries.
pay_detail: 2027 fees listed in CAD: course $1,995 for Canadian students (including permanent residents) or $2,700 international; mini school $2,175 Canadian or $2,940 international. Optional residence add-on $2,730. A $500 deposit is due when you register, and full payment is due by May 1, 2027. Fees can change. The President Bursary is for B.C. grade 11 students with financial need.
deadline_text: Registration opens Feb 2, 2027 at 9:00 am Pacific. Summer 2027 sessions: July 5 to 16, July 19 to 30 and Aug 2 to 13, 2027. Residence registration deadlines (noon): May 21, June 4 and June 18, 2027. Commuter deadlines (noon): June 18, July 2 and July 16, 2027. Residence can close sooner if full.
how_to_apply: No application, transcripts or proof of English are needed. Check that you are eligible. Add a course or mini school to your cart. Have a parent or guardian create a Family Account. Pay the deposit at checkout. Then finish the information package within 48 hours.
notes: Costs money, and it is a camp-style university course, not a job. This is in Canada, so British Columbia rules apply and this guide has not checked them. An online version also exists (3 week courses); this card covers the on-campus version.
